column3: \tリーザスに到着した。リーザス平原などで・・城である必要はないです。
column4: Arrived at Leazas. It can be on the Leazas plains, etc., no need for it to be a castle.

column3: \t最速で移動してきた。よーし、魔軍には俺様が魔人退治に現れたぞと
column4: I've moved here at top speed. Alright, let the Monster Army think I, the great one, have appeared to exterminate Fiends.

column3: \t思わせたらそれでいい、目立ちながら少し戦うぞ
column4: That's enough to make them think so; I will fight a little while standing out.

column3: \tがはははは、俺様率いる魔人討伐隊参上ー
column4: Gahahahaha! The Fiend Extermination Squad led by me has arrived!
